name: firecrawl
description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
one_liner: A single plug that lets any AI assistant read websites and pull in outside data, instead of being stuck only knowing what it was originally trained on.
buyer: A founder building an AI product that needs live, accurate web data (prices, listings, news) and doesn't want to build and maintain their own web scraper.
business_use_cases: A price-comparison startup builds its whole product on top of this instead of hiring engineers to maintain fragile scrapers.
An AI research assistant product uses it to pull live sources so its answers are current instead of frozen at training time.
A lead-generation agency scrapes public company sites at scale to build enriched prospect lists for sales teams.

money_ideas.idea: Usage-based API billing for scraping and search volume
A managed data-feed product built on top, sold as a subscription to a specific industry

steal_this: Build a narrow, single-industry 'live data' dashboard this weekend (e.g. local restaurant menu prices) powered by this, and pitch it to the first ten businesses in that niche.
